notes: 📱 Report panels un-stick on phones. Panels that open under the Market Radar (Top 20, scans) are pushed down past the radar's live bottom edge — and after the radar grew taller, that push could pin a panel to the bottom half of a phone screen, clipped and unable to scroll or expand. The rule is now “the panel always keeps at least 45% of the screen” (never less than 320px), and anything still too tall scrolls instead of clipping. Desktop keeps the tall-radar behaviour it wanted.
